plugin.name: SteamView
plugin.tagline: Live media preview for the highlighted game

settings.enabledDescription: Show a media preview for the highlighted game.
settings.previewDelayDescription: How long a game must stay highlighted before the preview appears. Applies in every mode. Lower values fetch more while scrolling.
settings.autoplayDelayDescription: Extra wait before the trailer starts, once the preview is showing. Trailer mode only.
settings.mutedDescription: Strongly recommended. Steam's own UI sounds keep playing underneath.
settings.loopDescription: Repeat the trailer while the game stays highlighted.
settings.dataSaverDescription: Skip video entirely and show screenshots only.
settings.clearCacheDescription: Delete cached media metadata. Use this if a preview looks wrong or stale.

status.focusUnavailableBody: SteamView could not hook into the library UI, most likely because a SteamOS update changed it. Your library is unaffected. Please report this with the plugin version and your SteamOS build.
